content:
[L] high | AI provider record card, Embedding model input | Input text truncated with ellipsis ("empty — embedding columns stay u..."), key content unreadable
[L] high | Bottom of window | Raw debug line "stored record: provider_kind=none chat_model=(unset)..." runs to the card edge and appears clipped at the window boundary
[L] med | Top header | Window title "AI Center" is clipped at the left/top edge, sitting flush against the window border with no inset
[L] med | Right half of the entire content area | Content occupies only the left ~40% of both cards; the right 60% is a dead empty zone from top to bottom
[S] high | Settings grid (top card) | Label column and value column inconsistently aligned: values start at ~145px but labels vary, and value column spacing differs row to row (e.g., "enabled" pill at 170 vs "lmstudio" at 145)
[S] med | Top card label/value rows | Vertical gaps between rows uneven visually (Concurrency/Timeout rows tighter than Chat/Embedding model rows)
[S] med | Top card, "Test Connection" area | Help text and button cramped together; button nearly touches the paragraph above with no breathing room
[S] low | Provider row (bottom card) | "None (no AI provider)" / "LM Studio" / "not configured" chips have inconsistent widths and gaps between them
[H] high | Bottom card, Provider row | Three competing control-like elements (dark selected chip, plain text "LM Studio", gray "not configured" badge) with no clear pattern — unclear which is label, value, or status
[H] med | "AI enabled: enabled" row | Label ends with a colon while every other label ("Provider", "Base URL", "Timeout") has none — inconsistent label typography
[H] med | Top card vs bottom card | Values in monospace ("lmstudio", "http://...") mixed with sans-serif labels and sans-serif values ("2") at equal weight — no typographic distinction between editable values and static data
[H] med | Bottom card subtitle | Tiny two-line gray explanation text smaller than any other body text; borderline unreadable
[H] low | Page title "AI Center" | No heading hierarchy: page title, section headings ("LM Studio settings", "AI provider record") and body text are near-identical size
[C] high | Whole screen | Two stacked cards on the same topic ("LM Studio settings" and "AI provider record (ai_settings)") duplicate Base URL/Chat model/Embedding model fields with no visual relationship — reads like a debug dump of two code paths
[C] med | Bottom card footer | Raw serde-style debug string "stored record: provider_kind=none chat_model=(unset)..." exposed as UI — unmistakably a debug tool artifact
[C] med | Top card, Base URL row | Raw localhost URL and raw "120000 ms" shown to end users with no formatting (e.g., "120s") — developer values, not product values
[C] low | Top card help paragraph | One long run-on sentence containing inline URLs and cross-references, denser than anything around it, sitting orphaned between grid and button
[C] low | Tabs row | Six tabs with large empty right side; tab bar spans full width while everything below hugs the left edge, unbalanced

VERDICT: unprofessional — duplicated debug-style config panels, truncated inputs, exposed raw record dumps, and vast dead whitespace make this read as an internal diagnostic screen, not a shippable helpdesk product.

Single mitigating note: the tab bar itself is legible and does not overlap other elements.
